name: uSonar Co.,Ltd.
summary: uSonar Co., Ltd. develops LBC, a corporate database offering B2B data, and operates the Usonar customer data integration platform, which supplies information on capital affiliations and headquarters and business unit relationships, and extracts lists using news, services and website visit data. It also provides mSonar, a business card management app, and Plansonar. Formerly Landscape Co., Ltd., it was renamed in 2022, incorporated in 1990 and has its base in Shinjuku, Japan.
